# Configuration reference

<!-- GENERATED by `bun scripts/env-gen.ts` from the registry in shared/env/ — edit the registry, not this file. -->

Every environment variable markoto reads or passes, grouped by area. The app, the sync server and the renderer validate their set at boot and refuse to start with a list of every problem (wrong type, missing required value, inconsistent combination). How to add a variable: [docs/contributing/configuration.md](../contributing/configuration.md).

- **Services** — which process reads it (`compose` = only the compose files / install.sh interpolate it). Some containers read the same value under another name, shown in brackets.
- **Scope** — `both` = self-hosted and hosted, `self-host`, `hosted`, `dev`, `test`.
- **Booleans** accept `true`/`false`, `1`/`0`, `yes`/`no`, `on`/`off`. An empty value means unset (the default applies), except where noted.

## Instance

Public address and runtime mode of this instance.

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Services | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NODE_ENV` | string |  |  | app, sync, renderer | both | `production` turns on production checks (required NUXT_SITE_URL, Postgres TLS, Secure cookies); the images set it. Not passed by the compose files: set by each image / the dev command; compose overrides it only on some services. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | debug \| info \| warn \| error | `info` |  | app, sync, renderer | both | Minimum level the app, the sync server and the renderer log (`debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`). Production writes one JSON object per line; see docs/operations/OBSERVABILITY.md. Not passed by the compose files: code default is enough; an operator who wants debug output adds it to the container environment. |
| `NUXT_SITE_URL` | http/https URL |  | in production | app, sync | both | Public origin of this instance (https://docs.example.org). Email links are built only from it, never from the request Host. |
| `NUXT_CANONICAL_SITE_URL` | http/https URL |  |  | app | hosted | Origin named by canonical / og:url / JSON-LD / sitemap. Empty = NUXT_SITE_URL (staging renders https://markoto.app). |
| `NUXT_DOCS_CANONICAL_BASE` | http/https URL |  |  | app | self-host | Origin the /docs pages' canonical links point to off the marketing site. Unset = https://markoto.app; set but empty = this instance. Set but empty is a value of its own. Not passed by the compose files: self-host compose only; the hosted instance is the marketing site and always self-canonical. |
| `NUXT_SITE_INDEXABLE` | boolean | `true` |  | app | both | false keeps the instance out of search engines (robots.txt Disallow: / + X-Robots-Tag: noindex everywhere). Staging renders false. |
| `NUXT_MARKETING_SITE_ENABLED` | boolean | `false` |  | app | hosted | "This instance is markoto.app": product tour at /, sitemap, JSON-LD, hosted-only marketing pages. Formerly `NUXT_PRODUCT_TOUR_ENABLED`. |
| `NUXT_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS` | integer ≥ 0 | `1` |  | app, sync (as `TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS`) | both | Reverse proxies in front of the app and sync server; the client IP is the N-th X-Forwarded-For entry from the right (0 = socket address). |
| `NUXT_ADMIN_USER_EMAILS` | string | (empty) |  | app | both | Comma-separated emails promoted to admin at their next sign-in with a VERIFIED address (case-insensitive). |

## App server

Bun HTTP server of the app container (server/runtime/bunEntry.ts reads these before Nitro starts).

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Services | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PORT` | integer 1–65535 | `3000` |  | app | both | Port the app listens on (NITRO_PORT wins when set). Not passed by the compose files: the image listens on 3000. |
| `NITRO_PORT` | integer 1–65535 |  |  | app | both | Overrides PORT for the app server. Not passed by the compose files: the image listens on 3000. |
| `NITRO_HOST` | string |  |  | app | both | Address the app server binds (HOST is read as a fallback). Default: all interfaces. Not passed by the compose files: the image binds all interfaces. |
| `HOST` | string |  |  | app | both | Fallback for NITRO_HOST. Not passed by the compose files: the image binds all interfaces. |
| `NITRO_BUN_IDLE_TIMEOUT` | integer ≥ 1 |  |  | app | both | Seconds an idle HTTP connection stays open (Bun default 10). Not passed by the compose files: Bun default. |
| `NITRO_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES` | integer ≥ 1 | `53477376` |  | app | both | Largest request body on any route, enforced by Bun before buffering (51 MiB = a 50 MB import plus form framing). Not passed by the compose files: default fits the 50 MB import limit. |
| `DRIZZLE_MIGRATIONS_DIR` | string | `./drizzle` |  | app | both | Directory the boot migration reads (the image ships ./drizzle). Not passed by the compose files: the image ships ./drizzle. |
| `NUXT_DB_SLOW_QUERY_MS` | integer ≥ 1 | `200` |  | app | both | Queries slower than this (ms) raise a warning-level Sentry event. Not passed by the compose files: tuning knob, default is fine. |

## Secrets

Signing and service-to-service secrets (≥ 32 chars each; `openssl rand -hex 32`). *_PREVIOUS only during a rotation (docs/operations/SECRETS-ROTATION.md).

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Services | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NUXT_SESSION_PASSWORD` | secret, ≥ 32 chars |  | always | app | both | Seals the session cookie (nuxt-auth-utils; runtimeConfig.session.password). Secret. |
| `NUXT_JWT_SECRET` | secret, ≥ 32 chars |  | always | app, sync (as `JWT_SECRET`) | both | Signs the document tokens the sync server verifies. Secret. |
| `NUXT_JWT_SECRET_PREVIOUS` | secret, ≥ 32 chars |  |  | app, sync (as `JWT_SECRET_PREVIOUS`) | both | Previous NUXT_JWT_SECRET, still accepted by verifiers during a rotation. Secret. |
| `NUXT_INTERNAL_API_SECRET` | secret, ≥ 32 chars |  | always | app, sync (as `INTERNAL_API_SECRET`), renderer (as `INTERNAL_API_SECRET`) | both | Shared secret of the app ↔ sync ↔ renderer internal HTTP calls and render tokens. Secret. |
| `NUXT_INTERNAL_API_SECRET_PREVIOUS` | secret, ≥ 32 chars |  |  | app, sync (as `INTERNAL_API_SECRET_PREVIOUS`), renderer (as `INTERNAL_API_SECRET_PREVIOUS`) | both | Previous NUXT_INTERNAL_API_SECRET, still accepted during a rotation. Secret. |
| `NUXT_ENCRYPTION_KEY` | secret, ≥ 32 chars |  | in production | app | both | Encrypts the secrets the app stores in Postgres (LiteLLM virtual keys, users' own AI provider keys, workspace SSO client secrets). Losing or replacing it makes them unreadable: rotate through NUXT_ENCRYPTION_KEY_PREVIOUS. Secret. |
| `NUXT_ENCRYPTION_KEY_PREVIOUS` | secret, ≥ 32 chars |  |  | app | both | Previous NUXT_ENCRYPTION_KEY, still used to decrypt during a rotation (then `bun run secrets:reencrypt`). Secret. |
| `NUXT_AI_DICTATE_JWT_SECRET` | secret, ≥ 32 chars |  |  | app | both | Signs live-dictation WebSocket tokens; empty = NUXT_JWT_SECRET. Secret. |

## Sign-in

Login is optional: with no provider configured the instance is anonymous-only. Each provider is all-or-nothing (boot fails on a half pair).

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Services | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NUXT_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID` | string |  | when NUXT_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET is set | app | both | GitHub OAuth app client id (runtimeConfig.oauth.github, read by nuxt-auth-utils). |
| `NUXT_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET` | string |  | when NUXT_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID is set | app | both | GitHub OAuth app client secret. Secret. |
| `NUXT_OAUTH_GITHUB_REDIRECT_URL` | http/https URL |  |  | app | self-host | Explicit GitHub callback URL (<public URL>/auth/github); empty = derived by nuxt-auth-utils. |
| `NUXT_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` | string |  | when NUXT_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET is set | app | both | Google OAuth client id (runtimeConfig.oauth.google). |
| `NUXT_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` | string |  | when NUXT_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is set | app | both | Google OAuth client secret. Secret. |
| `NUXT_OAUTH_GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URL` | http/https URL |  |  | app | self-host | Explicit Google callback URL (<public URL>/auth/google); empty = derived by nuxt-auth-utils. |
| `NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_ISSUER` | http/https URL |  | when NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_ID or _CLIENT_SECRET is set | app | self-host | OpenID Connect issuer (exact `issuer` of the IdP's discovery document). https only, except NODE_ENV=development / TEST_MODE. |
| `NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_ID` | string |  | when NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_ISSUER or _CLIENT_SECRET is set | app | self-host | OIDC client id (confidential client, auth-code flow + PKCE). |
| `NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` | string |  | when NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_ISSUER or _CLIENT_ID is set | app | self-host | OIDC client secret. Secret. |
| `NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_NAME` | string | (empty) |  | app | self-host | Sign-in button label ("Continue with <name>", max 40 chars); empty = "single sign-on". |
| `NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_SCOPES` | string | `openid email profile` |  | app | self-host | Space- or comma-separated scopes (openid is always added). |
| `NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_REDIRECT_URL` | http/https URL |  |  | app | self-host | Explicit OIDC redirect URI; default <NUXT_SITE_URL>/auth/oidc (never the request Host). |
| `NUXT_SSO_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS` | boolean | `false` |  | app | self-host | Let workspace SSO connections (OIDC/SAML metadata) point at private-network IdPs. Self-host only. |

## PostgreSQL

Connection parts (shared/utils/runtime/connectionStrings.ts builds the URL). Dev: the values below match docker-compose.dev.yml; the containerised stacks set the host themselves.

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Services | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POSTGRES_USER` | string |  | always | app, sync, backup, compose | both | Role the app and sync server connect as (the compose files substitute POSTGRES_APP_USER when set). Also the admin role of db-init and backups. |
| `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | string |  | always | app, sync, backup, compose | both | Password of POSTGRES_USER. Secret. |
| `POSTGRES_HOST` | string |  | always | app, sync, backup, compose | both | Database host (compose: `postgres`, or the managed cluster endpoint). |
| `POSTGRES_PORT` | integer 1–65535 | `5432` |  | app, sync, backup, compose | both | Database port. |
| `POSTGRES_DB` | string |  | always | app, sync, backup, compose | both | Database of the app (LiteLLM uses its own `litellm` database). |
| `PGSSL` | disable |  |  | app, sync | both | `disable` turns TLS to Postgres off (otherwise on in production). No other value is accepted. |
| `PGSSLROOTCERT` | string |  |  | app, sync, backup | hosted | Path of a CA PEM the Postgres server certificate is verified against (default: system CA bundle). Unreadable = boot fails. Not passed by the compose files: hosted only: prod compose passes it; self-host runs Postgres in the stack without TLS. |
| `POSTGRES_SSLMODE` | disable \| allow \| prefer \| require \| verify-ca \| verify-full |  |  | compose | hosted | libpq sslmode for LiteLLM's DATABASE_URL, db-init and the backup sidecar (managed Postgres: require). |
| `POSTGRES_APP_USER` | string |  |  | compose | both | Least-privilege role the app and sync server connect as (db-init creates it). Empty = POSTGRES_USER. |
| `POSTGRES_APP_PASSWORD` | string |  |  | compose | both | Password of POSTGRES_APP_USER. Secret. |
| `POSTGRES_LITELLM_USER` | string |  |  | compose | both | Role LiteLLM connects as (owner of the litellm database only). Empty = POSTGRES_USER. |
| `POSTGRES_LITELLM_PASSWORD` | string |  |  | compose | both | Password of POSTGRES_LITELLM_USER. Secret. |

Rate limits, locks and the sync server's per-document state.

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Services | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `VALKEY_HOST` | string |  | always | app, sync | both | Valkey host (compose: `valkey`). |
| `VALKEY_PORT` | integer 1–65535 | `6379` |  | app, sync | both | Valkey port. |
| `VALKEY_PASSWORD` | string |  |  | app, sync, compose | both | Valkey password (empty = no auth; the containerised stacks require one). Secret. |
| `VALKEY_DB` | integer ≥ 0 | `0` |  | app, sync | both | Logical database index. |
| `VALKEY_TLS_ENABLED` | boolean | `false` |  | app, sync | both | TLS to Valkey (rediss://) — for a managed or remote Valkey. Not passed by the compose files: opt-in for a managed Valkey; the stacks run Valkey on the internal network. |
| `VALKEY_TLS_CA_PATH` | string |  |  | app, sync | both | CA PEM for a provider with a private CA (default: system CA store). Not passed by the compose files: opt-in for a managed Valkey. |

## Object storage (S3)

Image uploads, knowledge originals and render artefacts. The renderer reads the same values without the NUXT_ prefix.

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Services | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NUXT_S3_ENDPOINT` | http/https URL |  | always | app, renderer (as `S3_ENDPOINT`) | both | S3 API endpoint the app (and renderer) talk to. |
| `NUXT_S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT` | http/https URL |  |  | app, renderer (as `S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT`) | self-host | Base URL browsers use for presigned URLs when it differs from NUXT_S3_ENDPOINT (self-host: the public origin). SigV4 signs the host. |
| `NUXT_S3_ACCESS_KEY` | string |  | always | app, renderer (as `S3_ACCESS_KEY`), backup (as `S3_ACCESS_KEY`) | both | S3 access key. Secret. |
| `NUXT_S3_SECRET_KEY` | string |  | always | app, renderer (as `S3_SECRET_KEY`), backup (as `S3_SECRET_KEY`) | both | S3 secret key. Secret. |
| `NUXT_S3_BUCKET` | string | `ypad` |  | app, renderer (as `S3_BUCKET`), backup (as `S3_BUCKET`) | both | Bucket name. |
| `S3_SSE` | string | `AES256` |  | renderer, backup | self-host | Server-side encryption header on render artefacts and backups; `none` (or set but empty) for backends without SSE-S3 (SeaweedFS). Set but empty is a value of its own. Not passed by the compose files: hosted keeps the AES256 default (OVH supports SSE-S3). |
| `NUXT_IMAGE_GC_RETENTION_DAYS` | integer ≥ 0 | `30` |  | app | both | Days a confirmed image must stay unreferenced before it is deleted (0 = image GC off). |

| `MARKITDOWN_CHILD_MEMORY_MB` | string |  |  | markitdown | both | Memory cap of the conversion child process. Not passed by the compose files: converter default. |
| `MARKITDOWN_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_MB` | string |  |  | markitdown | both | Largest inflated size of an uploaded archive (default 200). Not passed by the compose files: converter default. |
| `MARKITDOWN_MAX_ARCHIVE_ENTRIES` | string |  |  | markitdown | both | Most entries in an uploaded archive (default 10000). Not passed by the compose files: converter default. |
| `MARKITDOWN_MAX_COMPRESSION_RATIO` | string |  |  | markitdown | both | Highest compression ratio of an archive (default 100). Not passed by the compose files: converter default. |
| `MARKITDOWN_ARCHIVE_CHECK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | string |  |  | markitdown | both | Budget of the archive inflate check (default 20). Not passed by the compose files: converter default. |

## Sync server (Hocuspocus)

Real-time collaboration. NUXT_* values are read by the app; the rest by the sync server.

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Services | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NUXT_SYNC_INTERNAL_URL` | http/https URL | `http://localhost:4001` |  | app | both | Internal HTTP URL the app calls the sync server on. |
| `NUXT_PUBLIC_SYNC_URL` | ws/wss URL |  | always | app | both | WebSocket URL browsers connect to (runtimeConfig.public.syncUrl). |
| `PORT` | integer 1–65535 | `4001` |  | sync | both | Port the sync server listens on. |
| `APP_URL` | http/https URL |  |  | sync | both | Internal URL of the app for activity / comment snapshots; empty = those calls are skipped (dev). |
| `SYNC_MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES` | bytes (integer ≥ 1) | `17825792` |  | sync | both | Largest WebSocket frame (closed with 1009 above it). |
| `SYNC_MAX_UPDATE_BYTES` | bytes (integer ≥ 1) | `16777216` |  | sync | both | Largest single Y.js update. |
| `SYNC_MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES` | bytes (integer ≥ 1) | `16777216` |  | sync | both | Largest encoded document after an update (deletions always pass). |
| `SYNC_MAX_PREAUTH_BYTES` | bytes (integer ≥ 1) | `33554432` |  | sync | both | Bytes one connection may queue before its document authenticates. |
| `SYNC_MAX_PREAUTH_TOTAL_BYTES` | bytes (integer ≥ 1) | `268435456` |  | sync | both | Bytes all connections together may queue before authenticating. |
| `SYNC_AUTH_TIMEOUT_MS` | milliseconds (integer ≥ 1) | `15000` |  | sync | both | A connection that sends for a document without its token within this time is closed. |
| `SYNC_MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_IP` | integer ≥ 1 | 20 with NODE_ENV=production, 200 otherwise |  | sync | both | Open sync connections per client IP. |
| `COMPACT_THRESHOLD` | integer ≥ 1 | `500` |  | sync | both | A document is compacted once it has more stored update rows than this. |
| `COMPACT_INTERVAL_MS` | integer | `900000` |  | sync | both | How often the compaction sweep runs (ms); ≤ 0 = off. |
| `COMPACT_MAX_DOCS_PER_RUN` | integer ≥ 1 | `50` |  | sync | both | Most documents compacted per sweep. |

## Renderer (PDF / PNG)

Playwright sidecar that renders documents. Internal-only.

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Services | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NUXT_RENDERER_INTERNAL_URL` | http/https URL | `http://localhost:9000` |  | app | both | Internal URL of the renderer; set but empty disables PDF download and the AI's view_pages tool. Set but empty is a value of its own. |
| `RENDERER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | comma-separated http/https URL list | (empty) |  | app, renderer | both | Extra origins the renderer's Chromium may load (beyond the app and S3). Mirrored into the print page CSP: set it on app AND renderer. |
| `PORT` | integer 1–65535 | `9000` |  | renderer | both | Port the renderer listens on. |
| `APP_URL` | http/https URL | `http://app:3000` |  | renderer | both | Internal URL the renderer loads the print page from. |
| `RENDERER_CHROMIUM_SANDBOX` | boolean | `true` |  | renderer | both | Chromium's own sandbox; false only on hosts without unprivileged user namespaces. Not passed by the compose files: escape hatch, documented in docs/SECURITY-HARDENING.md. |
| `RENDERER_LOCALHOST_TARGET` | hostname | `host.docker.internal` |  | renderer | dev | Where Chromium resolves `localhost` (dev/test: the SeaweedFS container). Not passed by the compose files: dev/test stacks only. |

## LiteLLM proxy

Every platform-paid AI call goes through the self-hosted LiteLLM proxy (infra/litellm/). Per-user virtual keys carry the budgets.

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Services | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NUXT_LITELLM_URL` | http/https URL |  | always | app | both | Internal URL of the proxy. |
| `NUXT_LITELLM_MASTER_KEY` | secret |  | always | app | both | Admin key the app mints virtual keys with; must equal LITELLM_MASTER_KEY. Secret. |
| `LITELLM_MASTER_KEY` | secret |  | always | litellm, compose | both | Master key the proxy starts with (sk-…). Secret. |
| `LITELLM_SALT_KEY` | secret, ≥ 16 chars |  | always | litellm | both | Encrypts provider keys in LiteLLM's own database. Never change it on a running instance: LiteLLM can no longer read what it stored. Secret. |
| `NUXT_LITELLM_DB_URL` | postgres/postgresql URL |  |  | app | both | Full URL of LiteLLM's spend database for the app's spend reads; empty = built from the parts below + POSTGRES_HOST/PORT. Not passed by the compose files: the compose files pass the parts instead. |
| `NUXT_LITELLM_DB_USER` | string |  |  | app | both | Role the app reads LiteLLM's spend logs as; empty = POSTGRES_USER (and POSTGRES_PASSWORD). |
| `NUXT_LITELLM_DB_PASSWORD` | string |  |  | app | both | Password of NUXT_LITELLM_DB_USER. Secret. |
| `NUXT_LITELLM_DB_NAME` | string | `litellm` |  | app | both | LiteLLM's database name. Not passed by the compose files: the stacks use the default. |
| `NUXT_LITELLM_EMBEDDINGS_MODEL` | string | `jina-embeddings-v5-text-nano` |  | app | self-host | Embedding model alias for the knowledge base; `custom-embeddings` = the EMBEDDINGS_UPSTREAM_* deployment. |
| `NUXT_LITELLM_EMBEDDINGS_DIMS` | integer 1–2000 | `768` |  | app | self-host | Embedding size (the pgvector column is retyped at boot while empty; else `bun run knowledge:reembed`). |
| `NUXT_LITELLM_EMBEDDINGS_SEND_DIMENSIONS` | auto \| true \| false | `auto` |  | app | self-host | Send the OpenAI `dimensions` parameter (auto = Jina models only). |
| `NUXT_LITELLM_EMBEDDINGS_TASK_HINTS` | auto \| true \| false | `auto` |  | app | self-host | Send Jina's `task` parameter (auto = Jina models only). |
| `NUXT_LITELLM_EMBEDDINGS_UPSTREAM_MODEL` | string | (empty) |  | app | self-host | Label only (stored with the vectors): mirrors the proxy's EMBEDDINGS_UPSTREAM_MODEL. |
| `EMBEDDINGS_UPSTREAM_MODEL` | string |  |  | litellm | self-host | LiteLLM model id behind `custom-embeddings` (e.g. openai/text-embedding-3-small). |
| `EMBEDDINGS_UPSTREAM_API_BASE` | string |  |  | litellm | self-host | API base of the custom embeddings upstream. |
| `EMBEDDINGS_UPSTREAM_API_KEY` | string |  |  | litellm | self-host | API key of the custom embeddings upstream. Secret. |
| `NUXT_LITELLM_IMAGE_DEFAULT_WIDTH` | integer ≥ 1 | `1024` |  | app | both | Default width of generated images. Not passed by the compose files: tuning knob, default is fine. |
| `NUXT_LITELLM_IMAGE_DEFAULT_HEIGHT` | integer ≥ 1 | `1024` |  | app | both | Default height of generated images. Not passed by the compose files: tuning knob, default is fine. |
| `NUXT_LITELLM_REALTIME_TICK_MODEL` | string | `voxtral-realtime-tick` |  | app | both | Metering model billed once per minute of live dictation. Not passed by the compose files: matches infra/litellm/config.yaml. |

## AI provider keys

Platform-paid upstreams. MISTRAL / BFL / JINA are read by LiteLLM; JINA (fetch_url), STAAN (web_search) and MISTRAL (live dictation) also by the app.

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Services | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `JINA_AI_API_KEY` | string |  |  | app, litellm | both | Jina: embeddings (proxy) and the fetch_url tool (app). Empty = fetch_url not offered. Secret. |
| `MISTRAL_API_KEY` | string |  |  | app, litellm | both | Mistral (EU endpoint): chat / transcription deployments (proxy) and live dictation on the platform default (app). Secret. |
| `BFL_API_KEY` | string |  |  | litellm | both | Black Forest Labs image generation (proxy only). Secret. |
| `STAAN_API_KEY` | string |  |  | app | both | Staan web search for the web_search tool. Empty = web_search not offered. Secret. |
| `NUXT_WEB_TOOLS_HOURLY_LIMIT` | integer ≥ 0 | `30` |  | app | both | web_search + fetch_url calls per user per rolling hour (0 = unlimited). |
| `NUXT_WEB_TOOLS_DAILY_LIMIT` | integer ≥ 0 | `100` |  | app | both | web_search + fetch_url calls per user per rolling day (0 = unlimited). |

## AI defaults and bring-your-own-key

Per request: the user's own provider → the instance default below → unavailable. See docs/AI-MODELS.md.

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Services | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL` | string | (empty) |  | app | both | Instance default for chat: a LiteLLM alias (platform-paid), or with _BASE_URL + _API_KEY any OpenAI-compatible model. Empty = none. |
| `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_CHAT_BASE_URL` | http/https URL |  |  | app | self-host | OpenAI-compatible endpoint of the chat default (needs _MODEL and _API_KEY). |
| `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_CHAT_API_KEY` | string |  |  | app | self-host | API key for NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_CHAT_BASE_URL (any placeholder for servers that need none). Secret. |
| `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_CHAT_VISION` | boolean | `true` |  | app | both | The chat default accepts images (view_image / view_pages). |
| `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_CHAT_STRONG_MODEL` | string | (empty) |  | app | both | Stronger LiteLLM chat alias users may pick when their plan has aiStrongModel. Empty = default model only. |
| `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_IMAGE_MODEL` | string | (empty) |  | app | both | Instance default for image generation: a LiteLLM alias (platform-paid), or with _BASE_URL + _API_KEY any OpenAI-compatible model. Empty = none. |
| `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_IMAGE_BASE_URL` | http/https URL |  |  | app | self-host | OpenAI-compatible endpoint of the image generation default (needs _MODEL and _API_KEY). |
| `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_IMAGE_API_KEY` | string |  |  | app | self-host | API key for NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_IMAGE_BASE_URL (any placeholder for servers that need none). Secret. |
| `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_TRANSCRIBE_MODEL` | string | (empty) |  | app | both | Instance default for transcription: a LiteLLM alias (platform-paid), or with _BASE_URL + _API_KEY any OpenAI-compatible model. Empty = none. |
| `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_TRANSCRIBE_BASE_URL` | http/https URL |  |  | app | self-host | OpenAI-compatible endpoint of the transcription default (needs _MODEL and _API_KEY). |
| `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_TRANSCRIBE_API_KEY` | string |  |  | app | self-host | API key for NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_TRANSCRIBE_BASE_URL (any placeholder for servers that need none). Secret. |
| `NUXT_AI_REALTIME_MODEL` | string | `voxtral-mini-transcribe-realtime-2602` |  | app | both | Voxtral Realtime model for live dictation (Mistral only). |

| `NUXT_AI_BYOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS` | boolean | `false` |  | app | both | Let users point at private-network providers (Ollama, vLLM). Self-host only. |

## Billing

One codebase, three shapes: self-host (both off), hosted free-only (coming soon on), paid plans live (billing on → Stripe required in production).

| Variable | Type | Default | Required | Services | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NUXT_BILLING_ENABLED` | boolean | `false` |  | app | both | Stripe checkout / portal / webhooks and paid tiers are live. Off = everyone on the free tier, billing endpoints 404. |
| `NUXT_PLANS_COMING_SOON` | boolean | `false` |  | app | hosted | With billing off: show paid plans as "coming soon" + the waitlist (hosted free-only SaaS). |
| `NUXT_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` | string |  | when NUXT_BILLING_ENABLED=true and NODE_ENV=production | app | hosted | Stripe secret key. Secret. |
| `NUXT_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | string |  | when NUXT_BILLING_ENABLED=true and NODE_ENV=production | app | hosted | Stripe webhook signing secret. Secret. |
| `NUXT_STRIPE_API_BASE` | http/https URL |  |  | app | test | Override the Stripe API base (stripe-mock in tests). Not passed by the compose files: test stacks only. |
| `NUXT_STRIPE_LOOKUP_KEY_PREFIX` | letters, digits and "-" only | `markoto` |  | app | hosted | Prefix of the Stripe price lookup keys (<prefix>_<plan>_<month\|year>_<eur\|chf>). |
| `NUXT_STRIPE_PRICE_IDS` | string | (empty) |  | app | hosted | Explicit `lookup_key=price_id` pairs, comma-separated, for setups without lookup keys. |
| `NUXT_STRIPE_AUTOMATIC_TAX` | boolean | `false` |  | app | hosted | Stripe Tax on checkout (only after activating Stripe Tax in the dashboard). |
| `NUXT_STRIPE_SUCCESS_URL` | string | `/pricing?checkout=success&session={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}` |  | app | hosted | Path Stripe returns to after a successful checkout. Not passed by the compose files: the default is the app's own page. |
| `NUXT_STRIPE_CANCEL_URL` | string | `/pricing?checkout=cancelled` |  | app | hosted | Path Stripe returns to after a cancelled checkout. Not passed by the compose files: the default is the app's own page. |

## Plan limits and feature switches

## Published pages and custom domains

Publishing at /p/<slug> always works. A pages host of its own is required for the hosted shape; custom domains need a CNAME target that reaches this instance's Traefik.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NUXT_PUBLISH_PAGES_HOST` | string |  | when NUXT_LEGAL_SURFACES_ENABLED=true | app | both | Hostname published pages are served from (pages.example.org, or an https:// origin). Must differ from the app host. Empty = the app's own origin. |
| `NUXT_PUBLISH_DOMAINS_TARGET` | hostname |  |  | app | both | Host customers point their CNAME at. Empty = custom domains off. |
| `NUXT_PUBLISH_DNS_SERVERS` | comma-separated list | (empty) |  | app | test | host:port DNS servers for the custom-domain check (default: the system's). Not passed by the compose files: test stacks only. |
| `NUXT_PUBLISH_TRAEFIK_TOKEN` | secret, ≥ 32 chars |  | when NUXT_LEGAL_SURFACES_ENABLED=true and NUXT_PUBLISH_PAGES_HOST is set | app, compose | both | Token Traefik's HTTP provider sends to /api/internal/traefik/custom-domains. Unset = the endpoint is off. Secret. |
| `NUXT_PUBLISH_TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT` | string | `websecure` |  | app | both | Traefik entry point of the generated routers. Not passed by the compose files: the stacks use the default. |
| `NUXT_PUBLISH_TRAEFIK_CERT_RESOLVER` | string | `le` |  | app | both | Traefik certificate resolver of the generated routers. Not passed by the compose files: the stacks use the default. |
| `NUXT_PUBLISH_TRAEFIK_SERVICE` | string | `app@docker` |  | app | self-host | Existing Traefik service the generated routers point at. |
| `NUXT_PUBLISH_TRAEFIK_UPSTREAM` | http/https URL |  |  | app | test | Upstream URL to declare a service for instead of NUXT_PUBLISH_TRAEFIK_SERVICE (test stacks). Not passed by the compose files: test stacks only. |
| `NUXT_PUBLISH_TRAEFIK_MIDDLEWARES` | comma-separated list | (empty) |  | app | both | Traefik middlewares attached to the generated routers. |
| `NUXT_PUBLISH_TRAEFIK_PAGES_ROUTER` | boolean | `false` |  | app | self-host | Also emit the pages host's router from the HTTP provider (self-host HTTPS overlay). Not passed by the compose files: set by docker-compose.selfhost.tls.yml. |

Set by the integration and flow test harnesses; release images are built without it, so those routes do not exist there. Not passed by the compose files: set by the test harness for its own build only. |

## Cross-field rules

Checked at boot after every value parsed. Rules marked *warning* only log; *relaxed* ones are skipped in test mode.

| Rule | Variables | |
|---|---|---|
| TEST_MODE=1 is refused on an instance whose NUXT_SITE_URL is a real host. | `TEST_MODE`, `NUXT_SITE_URL` |  |
| A pages host needs NUXT_SITE_URL (links from a page back to the app are built from it). | `NUXT_PUBLISH_PAGES_HOST`, `NUXT_SITE_URL` | relaxed |
| NUXT_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and NUXT_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET are set together or not at all. | `NUXT_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID`, `NUXT_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET` | relaxed |
| NUXT_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and NUXT_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET are set together or not at all. | `NUXT_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `NUXT_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` | relaxed |
| OIDC issuer, client id and secret are set together or not at all. | `NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_ISSUER`, `NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_ID`, `NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` | relaxed |
| The OIDC issuer is https (http only with NODE_ENV=development or TEST_MODE) and has no query or fragment. | `NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_ISSUER` |  |
| With OIDC configured, NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_REDIRECT_URL or NUXT_SITE_URL is set (never the request Host). | `NUXT_OAUTH_OIDC_REDIRECT_URL`, `NUXT_SITE_URL` | relaxed |
| A half-configured AI instance default is ignored (warning at boot). | `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL`, `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_CHAT_BASE_URL`, `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_CHAT_API_KEY`, `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_IMAGE_MODEL`, `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_IMAGE_BASE_URL`, `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_IMAGE_API_KEY`, `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_TRANSCRIBE_MODEL`, `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_TRANSCRIBE_BASE_URL`, `NUXT_AI_DEFAULT_TRANSCRIBE_API_KEY` | warning |
| Billing on in production needs the Stripe secret key and webhook secret. | `NUXT_BILLING_ENABLED`, `NUXT_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `NUXT_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | relaxed |
| The legal pages need the operator's postal address and representative. | `NUXT_LEGAL_SURFACES_ENABLED`, `NUXT_LEGAL_CONTROLLER_ADDRESS`, `NUXT_LEGAL_REPRESENTED_BY` | relaxed |
| The hosted shape restricts user-supplied AI provider URLs to an allowlist. | `NUXT_LEGAL_SURFACES_ENABLED`, `NUXT_AI_BYOK_ALLOWED_BASE_URLS` | relaxed |
| The hosted shape serves published pages from their own host, routed through the token-protected Traefik provider. | `NUXT_LEGAL_SURFACES_ENABLED`, `NUXT_PUBLISH_PAGES_HOST`, `NUXT_PUBLISH_TRAEFIK_TOKEN` | relaxed |
| The anonymous gate needs its ALTCHA key. | `NUXT_ANON_GATE_ENABLED`, `NUXT_LEGAL_SURFACES_ENABLED`, `NUXT_ALTCHA_HMAC_KEY` | relaxed |
